name: ThreeDFormat
remarks: You cannot apply three-dimensional formatting to some kinds of shapes, such as beveled shapes or multiple-disjoint paths. Most of the properties and methods of the ThreeDFormat object for such a shape will fail.
example:
Set myDocument = Worksheets(1)
Set myShape = myDocument.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeOval, _
 90, 90, 90, 40)
With myShape.ThreeD
 .Visible = True
 .Depth = 50
 .ExtrusionColor.RGB = RGB(255, 100, 255)
 ' RGB value for purple
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Depth
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single value that represents the depth of the shape's extrusion.

properties.name: ExtrusionColor
properties.description: Returns a ColorFormat object that represents the color of the shape's extrusion. Read-only.

properties.name: ExtrusionColorType
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether the extrusion color is based on the extruded shape's fill (the front face of the extrusion) and automatically changes when the shape's fill changes, or whether the extrusion color is independent of the shape's fill. Read/write MsoExtrusionColorType.

properties.name: Perspective
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoTriState value that determines whether the extrusion appears in perspective.

properties.name: PresetExtrusionDirection
properties.description: Returns the direction that the extrusion's sweep path takes away from the extruded shape (the front face of the extrusion). Read-only MsoPresetExtrusionDirection.

properties.name: PresetLightingDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the light source relative to the extrusion. Read/write MsoPresetLightingDirection.

properties.name: PresetLightingSoftness
properties.description: Returns or sets the intensity of the extrusion lighting. Read/write MsoPresetLightingSoftness.

properties.name: PresetMaterial
properties.description: Returns or sets the extrusion surface material. Read/write MsoPresetMaterial.

properties.name: PresetThreeDFormat
properties.description: Returns the preset extrusion format. Each preset extrusion format contains a set of preset values for the various properties of the extrusion. Read-only MsoPresetThreeDFormat.

properties.name: RotationX
properties.description: Returns or sets the rotation of the extruded shape around the x-axis in degrees. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value indicates upward rotation; a negative value indicates downward rotation. Read/write Single.

properties.name: RotationY
properties.description: Returns or sets the rotation of the extruded shape around the y-axis in degrees. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value indicates rotation to the left; a negative value indicates rotation to the right. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoTriState value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: PresetLighting
properties.description: Returns or sets the extrusion preset lighting for a ThreeDFormat object. Read-only MsoLightRigType.

properties.name: Z
properties.description: Returns the Z order of the specified ThreeDFormat object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: BevelTopType
properties.description: Returns or sets the top bevel type for a ThreeDFormat object. Read/write MsoBevelType.

properties.name: BevelTopInset
properties.description: Returns or sets a value indicating whether the top insert bevel should be raised for a ThreeDFormat object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: BevelTopDepth
properties.description: Returns or sets the top depth when using the bevel effect on a ThreeDFormat object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: BevelBottomType
properties.description: Returns or sets the bottom bevel type for a ThreeDFormat object. Read/write MsoBevelType.

properties.name: BevelBottomInset
properties.description: Returns or sets a value indicating whether the bottom insert bevel should be raised for a ThreeDFormat object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: BevelBottomDepth
properties.description: Returns or sets the bottom depth when using the bevel effect on a ThreeDFormat object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: PresetCamera
properties.description: Returns or sets the extrusion preset camera for a ThreeDFormat object. Read-only MsoPresetCamera.

properties.name: RotationZ
properties.description: Returns or sets the rotation of the extruded shape around the z-axis in degrees. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value indicates upward rotation; a negative value indicates downward rotation. Read/write Single.

properties.name: ContourWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the contour width for a ThreeDFormat object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: ContourColor
properties.description: Returns the contour color for a ThreeDFormat object. Read-only ColorFormat.

properties.name: FieldOfView
properties.description: Returns or sets the angle at which a ThreeDFormat object can be viewed. Read/write Single.

properties.name: ProjectText
properties.description: Returns or sets the project text state for the specified ThreeDFormat object. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: LightAngle
properties.description: Returns or sets the angle of the extrusion lights set on a ThreeDFormat object. Read/write Single.

methods.name: IncrementRotationX
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the x-axis by the specified number of degrees. Use the RotationX property to set the absolute rotation of the shape around the x-axis.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the shape around the x-axis is to be changed. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value tilts the shape up; a negative value tilts it down.

methods.name: IncrementRotationY
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the y-axis by the specified number of degrees. Use the RotationY property to set the absolute rotation of the shape around the y-axis.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the shape around the y-axis is to be changed. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value tilts the shape to the left; a negative value tilts it to the right.

methods.name: ResetRotation
methods.description: Resets the extrusion rotation around the x-axis and the y-axis to 0 (zero) so that the front of the extrusion faces forward. This method doesn't reset the rotation around the z-axis.

methods.name: SetThreeDFormat
methods.description: Sets the preset extrusion format. Each preset extrusion format contains a set of preset values for the various properties of the extrusion.

parameters.name: PresetThreeDFormat
parameters.description: Specifies a preset extrusion format that corresponds to one of the options (numbered from left to right, from top to bottom) displayed when you choose the 3D button on the Drawing toolbar.

methods.name: SetExtrusionDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction that the extrusion's sweep path takes away from the extruded shape.

methods.name: SetPresetCamera
methods.description: Sets the camera for the specified ThreeDFormat object.

methods.name: IncrementRotationZ
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the z-axis by the specified number of degrees. Use the RotationZ property to set the absolute rotation of the shape around the z-axis.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the shape around the z-axis is to be changed. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value tilts the shape to the left; a negative value tilts it to the right.

methods.name: IncrementRotationHorizontal
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape horizontally by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the shape is to be changed horizontally. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value moves the shape left; a negative value moves it to the right.

methods.name: IncrementRotationVertical
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape vertically by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the shape is to be changed vertically. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value tilts the shape up; a negative value tilts it down.
